name: Dranos Velador

abilities.name: Carve
abilities.description: Dranos slashes at the player with his dagger dealing moderate physical damage.

abilities.name: Bleed
abilities.description: A moderate physical damage over time applied by Carve.

abilities.name: Blade Weaver
abilities.description: Dranos will spin around after a short windup, doing damage around him as indicated by a small red circle. Even though the block telegraph comes up it is recommended for all players especially non-tanks to dodge this attack, as it deals a massive amount of damage to tanks even when blocked.

abilities.name: Searing Seal
abilities.description: Dranos teleports to each player and places a fiery glyph on the ground under their feet as indicated by red circles. This deals moderate magical damage over time.

abilities.name: Fangs of Mephala
abilities.description: Immediately after Searing Seal, Dranos will teleport to a player (usually the tank) and two Gloom Wraiths will appear and stun that player. Other players must interrupt these NPCs as soon as possible to free the player, and the targeted player has to block the incoming heavy attack. Again, this attack deals massive damage, and non-tanks are likely to die even if they block. Rolling at the moment he swings may help you avoid death.

abilities.name: Summon Shade of Dranos[verification needed]
abilities.description: At approximately 66% and 33% health Dranos will become invincible and four Shades of Dranos will appear around the room to attack the group. Killing the Shades will cause them to drop an Essence of Dranos. Touching the Essence will return it to the boss, and once all four Essences are collected the boss will be stunned momentarily, after which he will be vulnerable again. The boss will continue to attack the group as per normal, so this phase has to be dealt with quickly. If the boss himself touches the Shades they will return to him, this may allow the group to quickly bypass this phase if the tank uses Fiery Grip or similar abilities to pull all the adds towards the boss. Killing Dranos without killing the Shades will award an achievement.

abilities.name: Orb of Spite
abilities.description: The Statue of Mephala in the center will release orbs of magic that explode in a large area as indicated by a red circle, dealing high magical damage. This has to be avoided at all costs.

abilities.name: Wrath of Mephala
abilities.description: When the boss is low on health, the Statue of Mephala will instead emit constant waves of magic, dealing moderately high magical damage. Players are advised to stay near the edges of the room to avoid being hit by these waves.

dialogue.speaker: Hides-the-Ashes
dialogue.line: I heard screeching. Giant spiders? No surprise there... wait.
dialogue.trigger: After defeating the Votary of Velidreth, Hides-the-Ashes enters the room

dialogue.line: <She notices a grate. You can see into the room below through it; the room behind the door you unlocked with the lever.>
dialogue.trigger: After defeating the Votary of Velidreth, Hides-the-Ashes enters the room

dialogue.speaker: Hides-the-Ashes
dialogue.line: It's the Ring's field captain, Dranos Velador and... no. No, no, no.
dialogue.trigger: After defeating the Votary of Velidreth, Hides-the-Ashes enters the room

dialogue.line: <She sees Tsatva-Lan standing before Dranos Velador, surrounded by his dead fellow Shadowscales. Dranos is flanked on both sides by four Spiderkith.>
dialogue.trigger: After defeating the Votary of Velidreth, Hides-the-Ashes enters the room

dialogue.speaker: Tsatva-Lan
dialogue.line: It is done, Velador. The remaining Shadowscales are dealt with.
dialogue.trigger: After defeating the Votary of Velidreth, Hides-the-Ashes enters the room

dialogue.speaker: Dranos Velador
dialogue.line: I'm afraid you're mistaken, my friend. Another member of your tribe has breached the gates.
dialogue.trigger: After defeating the Votary of Velidreth, Hides-the-Ashes enters the room

dialogue.speaker: Tsatva-Lan
dialogue.line: Hides-the-Ashes. If she is here, she will die like the rest. Now, you wanted proof of my loyalty? Bear witness.
dialogue.trigger: After defeating the Votary of Velidreth, Hides-the-Ashes enters the room

dialogue.speaker: Geel-Ma
dialogue.line: Tsatva-Lan, what are you—? You do not need to do this!
dialogue.trigger: After defeating the Votary of Velidreth, Hides-the-Ashes enters the room

dialogue.speaker: Geel-Ma
dialogue.line: No!
dialogue.trigger: After defeating the Votary of Velidreth, Hides-the-Ashes enters the room

dialogue.line: <Tsatva-Lan stabs Geel-Ma, killing him instantly. His corpse glows with an ominous red aura, and the Spiderkith begin channeling that energy.>
dialogue.trigger: After defeating the Votary of Velidreth, Hides-the-Ashes enters the room

dialogue.speaker: Dranos Velador
dialogue.line: Well done, my scaled friend. You have cast off your old skin, and the Silken Ring welcomes you as a brother. Seek out Velidreth and receive your blessing.
dialogue.trigger: After defeating the Votary of Velidreth, Hides-the-Ashes enters the room

dialogue.speaker: Hides-the-Ashes
dialogue.line: "I need a moment to... sort this out. Kill that smoke-skin bastard, Dranos, and we'll regroup afterward.
dialogue.trigger: After defeating the Votary of Velidreth, Hides-the-Ashes enters the room

dialogue.line: You've worn out your welcome.
Sorry, this affair is invitation only.
Kindly die now.
This should be refreshing!
Care to dance?
You think I'm surrounded? How cute.
Time to sweep you away.
Hope you've practiced your guard.
And who will die next?
Boo.
Nowhere to run, nowhere to hide.
Who will be the weak link?
Too slow.
Goodbye now.
Don't keep our lady waiting.
You won't suffer too long.
I don't die that easy.
Mephala! Lend me your power!
Did you really think you could kill me?
Who's outnumbered now?
Hmm, I should have toyed with them a little longer.
Don't fight it. You never stood a chance.
The Lady's will be done.
Death is my domain. I won't be bested at it.
The Lady will toy with you, and you will beg for death before it's over.

notes: He is the author of Dranos's Diary and From the Journal of Dranos Velador, Field Captain of the Silken Ring.
related_quests: Silk and Shadow: Help a former Shadowscale destroy a dangerous new group of assassins.
Pledge: Cradle of Shadows: Prove you are truly Undaunted by clearing the Cradle of Shadows.
summary: Dranos Velador is a rogue Dark Elf assassin who founded the Silken Ring in service to Mephala. He can be found in the Cradle of Shadows, where he acts as the fourth boss.
